rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: ta.crossover(close, pivot_high.price) or ta.crossunder(close, pivot_low.price) where crossed == false.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: Break in direction of current trend = BOS; break against current trend = CHOCH (trend flips).
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: Compares break direction against detector state trend bias.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: array.slice(pivot_index, break_index): includes broken pivot (inclusive), excludes break candle (exclusive).
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: Range [search_start, search_end) from broken pivot index to break candle index.
rule_specifications.evidence_source: LuxAlgo Pine Script slice implementation & order_blocks.py

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: Bullish OB: min parsed_low in slice; Bearish OB: max parsed_high in slice.
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: Min parsed_low for bullish, max parsed_high for bearish in volatility-parsed slice.
rule_specifications.notes: Exact match when using identical ATR-parsed candles.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: OB box spans extreme candle full range [candle.low, candle.high].
Bullish OB invalidated when candle.close < bottom_price; Bearish OB invalidated when candle.close > top_price.
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: check_invalidation checks candle.close beyond opposite OB boundary.
rule_specifications.notes: Close-based invalidation matches default LuxAlgo SMC.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: Wick touch (candle.low <= top_price for bullish) flags zone as mitigated / touched.
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: check_touch checks candle overlap with zone; transitions FRESH -> TOUCHED.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: Discretionary / Reference setups typically place Limit at Proximal Edge (0.0% depth) or 50% Midline.
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: Dynamic: Edge for narrow OB (<=0.6%), 25% depth for wide OB (>0.6%).
rule_specifications.evidence_source: TradingView SMC trading manuals vs StrategyEngine.evaluate_state
rule_specifications.notes: QuantEdge penetrates 25% into wide OBs, causing delayed/unfilled entries relative to proximal limit.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: Distal Edge or Distal Edge + small buffer (0.1-0.2 ATR) to prevent wick-outs.
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: Exact distal edge (bottom_price for Long, top_price for Short) with 0 buffer.
rule_specifications.evidence_source: TradingView SMC risk management guidelines vs OrderBlock.calculate_stop_loss
rule_specifications.notes: Zero buffer makes QuantEdge vulnerable to exact distal edge wick-outs.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: Target at opposing Swing Liquidity (Swing High/Low) or fixed 1:2 / 1:3 RR.
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: Fixed 1.714R target (60/35 ratio) regardless of market structure or swing levels.
rule_specifications.evidence_source: TradingView SMC target placement vs StrategyEngine 1.714R config
rule_specifications.notes: QuantEdge uses static R-multiple rather than dynamic structural liquidity targets.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: Backtesting engine in TradingView evaluates high/low bar order (typically optimistic in simple backtests).
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: Conservative: if TP and SL touched in same candle, SL hit is assumed first (-1.0R).
rule_specifications.notes: TradingView strategy tester can give optimistic fills; QuantEdge strictly enforces conservative SL-first.

rule_specifications.luxalgo_behavior: Chart indicator displays all active OBs simultaneously across charts without global mutex.
rule_specifications.quantedge_behavior: Phase T evaluates independent per-asset setups (up to 4 concurrent positions).
